en: As much as you need or want; or to the necessary degree.
ex: We have enough food for everyone.
我們有足夠的食物給每個人。

en: To come or go into a place; or to join a competition; or to type information into a computer.
ex: Please knock before you enter the room.
進房間前請先敲門。

en: A flat paper cover that you put a letter in before sending it.
ex: She put the letter in an envelope and sealed it.
她把信放進信封並封好。

en: A small piece of rubber used for removing pencil marks.
ex: Use an eraser to remove the wrong answer.
用橡皮擦擦掉錯誤的答案。

en: A mistake, especially in a calculation, computer program or judgment.
ex: The computer showed an error message.
電腦顯示了一則錯誤訊息。

en: Used to show surprise; or flat and smooth; or the same; or an even number can be divided by two.
ex: Even a child can understand this book.
連小孩都看得懂這本書。

en: The part of the day between the afternoon and night.
ex: We often take a walk in the evening.
我們常在晚上散步。

en: At any time; or always.
ex: Have you ever been to Japan?
你去過日本嗎？

en: Each one of a group, without exception.
ex: Every student must wear a school uniform.
每個學生都必須穿制服。

en: All the people in a group.
ex: Everyone in the class passed the exam.
班上每個人都通過了考試。

en: All things; the whole of something.
ex: She packed everything she needed for the trip.
她打包了旅行需要的一切東西。

en: Something that shows what a group of things is like; or a model to follow.
ex: Can you give me an example of a mammal?
你能舉個哺乳動物的例子嗎？

en: Extremely good; of a very high quality.
ex: She did an excellent job on the project.
她在這個專案上做得非常出色。

en: Not including; or used to say something is the only exception.
ex: Everyone was there except Tom.
除了湯姆之外，大家都在。

en: Feeling very happy and interested about something that is going to happen.
ex: The children are excited about the trip.
孩子們對這趟旅行感到興奮。

en: Making you feel very happy and interested; full of excitement.
ex: It was an exciting football match.
那是一場刺激的足球賽。

en: Physical activity that you do to stay healthy; or a task for practice; or to use a skill or power.
ex: Regular exercise is good for your health.
規律運動對你的健康有益。

en: To think that something will happen; or to wait for someone or something to arrive.
ex: I expect to arrive at six o'clock.
我預計六點到。

en: Costing a lot of money.
ex: This restaurant is too expensive for students.
這家餐廳對學生來說太貴了。

en: Knowledge or skill gained by doing something for a long time; or something that happens to you.
ex: She has five years of experience in teaching.
她有五年的教學經驗。

en: To tell someone about something so that they can understand it.
ex: Can you explain how this machine works?
你能解釋這台機器怎麼運作嗎？

en: One of the two organs in your face that you see with; or to look at something carefully.
ex: She has bright blue eyes.
她有一雙明亮的藍眼睛。

en: The front part of your head with eyes, nose and mouth; or to turn toward something; or to deal with a problem.
ex: She had a big smile on her face.
她臉上帶著大大的笑容。

en: Something that is known to be true or to have happened.
ex: It is a fact that the earth goes around the sun.
地球繞著太陽轉是個事實。

en: A large building where goods are made by machines.
ex: My uncle works in a car factory.
我叔叔在一家汽車工廠上班。

en: To not succeed in doing something; or to not pass a test.
ex: He failed the driving test twice.
他兩次駕照考試都沒通過。

en: To move quickly down toward the ground; or the season between summer and winter; or a drop.
ex: Leaves fall from the trees in autumn.
秋天時樹葉從樹上掉落。

en: A group of people who are related to each other, such as parents and children.
ex: There are five people in my family.
我家有五個人。

en: Known by many people because of being special or good at something.
ex: Paris is famous for its art and food.
巴黎以藝術和美食聞名。

en: A machine that moves air to make you feel cool; or a person who strongly supports a sport or a performer.
ex: She is a big fan of that singer.
她是那位歌手的忠實粉絲。

en: A long distance away; or by a large amount.
ex: The school is not far from my house.
學校離我家不遠。

en: An area of land and buildings used for growing crops or raising animals; or to grow crops.
ex: They live on a farm in the countryside.
他們住在鄉下的一座農場。

en: A person who owns or works on a farm.
ex: The farmer grows rice and vegetables.
農夫種植稻米和蔬菜。

en: Moving or happening quickly; or firmly fixed; or to eat no food for a period.
ex: She is a fast runner and always wins races.
她跑得很快，總是贏得比賽。

en: A soft, oily substance in animals and food; or having a lot of body fat.
ex: Fried food has a lot of fat in it.
油炸食物含有很多脂肪。

en: A man who has a child; or a title for a Catholic priest.
ex: My father works in a bank.
我父親在銀行工作。

en: To give food to a person or animal; or food for animals; or an act of eating.
ex: She feeds the birds in the garden every morning.
她每天早上餵花園裡的鳥。

en: To experience an emotion or physical sensation; or to touch something to learn about it; or to think something.
ex: I feel tired after the long walk.
長途走路後我覺得很累。

en: A special day or period of time when people celebrate something; or an event with music or film.
ex: The Lantern Festival is held in the first month of the year.
元宵節在一年的第一個月舉行。

en: Not many; a small number of.
ex: Few people came to the meeting because of the rain.
因為下雨，很少人來參加會議。
